work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCVII (protocol GREGORIUS PP. XVI. ad perpetuam rei memoriam LF36140–36143) erects, on the advice of the Propaganda cardinals, a new diocese with its see at Detroit comprising Michigan and the North-West territory, suffragan to Baltimore, and ends with its own 8 March 1833 closing at LF36225; its provenance note 1 (Ex Iure Pont. de P. F.) follows at LF36228, before numeral CCVIII at LF36231. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF36140–36140; the source closing at LF36222–36225 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die octava martii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pontificatus No- stri anno tertio. The excluded block LF36155–36162 is a top-edge speck, the running title and two right-edge specks of native leaf 252. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
